sources: TT Electronics (BI Technologies) P160 Series panel potentiometer, issue C (06/2021), LCSC's copy for C6249458 (P160KNP-0QC20A250K) https://datasheet.lcsc.com/datasheet/pdf/01ead58744deb67a1c53d901897cbb62.pdf?productCode=C6249458, read 2026-11-03 (its tables are images, read from the pages)

p. 1 ordering scheme: P160, KN = side adjust with PC pins, 0 = no detent, Q-type shaft, C = full-CCW position, shaft length 15, taper A (A = audio), the total resistance 250K; p. 2: resistance range 500 Ω … 1 MΩ – 250K is not among the standard values of p. 3, but TT sells it: the catalogue's P160KNP-0QC20A250K (C6249458, solder lugs, 20 mm shaft)

p. 2: ±20 % resistance tolerance, power rated 0.2 W (B taper) and 0.1 W (others), operating temperature −20 … +70 °C; p. 3 circuit diagram: CCW end, S (the wiper), CW end – pins 1, 2, 3 as the design's symbol Device:R_Potentiometer_US (2 the wiper)

stand-in: the schematic names the value and taper (POT3 A250K, 'Volume') and a board-mounted 16 mm footprint (random_input:Potentiometer_Single_3_Horizontal), not a maker – the P160 is the open designs' pot (guitarml-ts-rat-combo)

verified.datasheet: TT Electronics (BI Technologies) P160 Series panel potentiometer, issue C (06/2021)
open: an order code built by the data sheet's scheme – no LCSC number for the PC-pin version in the catalogue
250K is no standard value of p. 3
